name: method-press-acos-health-check
description: A free Amazon Sponsored Products PPC diagnostic from Method Press. Calculates ACoS, break-even ACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and CPC from a single snapshot, then walks a five-cause diagnostic to identify whether the real problem is targeting, bid, price, reviews, or the listing itself. Dual-mode: pulls numbers via the Amazon Ads MCP Server when connected, or accepts them pasted in. Read-only.
